initialExam.title: Karnataka Police Constable 2026
initialExam.description: Karnataka Police Constable recruitment for civil police, KAR, and KSRP constable posts in Karnataka state police.
initialExam.syllabus: GK, Kannada, English, Math, Science, Karnataka History.
initialExam.examPattern: Written: 100 marks, 90 minutes. PET. ET (Endurance Test).
initialExam.selectionProcess: Written Test → PET → ET → Medical → Merit
initialExam.jobRole: Police Constable in Karnataka State Police
initialExam.careerGrowth: Constable → Head Constable → ASI → PSI → PI → DSP.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit ksp.karnataka.gov.in 2. Register 3. Apply 4. Pay fee 5. Submit
initialExam.perks: DA, HRA, Medical, Uniform, Pension, Quarters
